rules.justification: Rule emb_order (docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md, 'Embedded interface model'): the interface element order, or which of two exact duplicates survives, differs from the oracle's (UD-408: upstream's std::set with the invalid comparator segmentPairsLess depends on the CGAL AABB tree's traversal order, which the LGPL search structure cannot reproduce). The replay first establishes that the pieces are the same (bitwise end points; a different background element only for a piece on an edge shared by both elements, where the contributions are equal in exact arithmetic) and puts the port's data in the oracle's order; the assembled values then differ only by the summation order of the element contributions at shared nodes. Bound: an entry of K is a sum of at most m <= 12 contributions (pieces touching the dof pair) of magnitude <= max|K|, so reordering changes it by at most m * eps * max|K| = 12 * 1.1e-16 * max|K| = 1.3e-15 max|K| -> 1e-14 (scale max_abs); the residual and the energies of a prescribed field inherit that bound per element sum, the solved displacement amplifies the perturbation of K by kappa(K) (TEST-127: kappa ~ 1e2..1e3 for 10840 dofs of a well-shaped mesh) -> 1e-12 (scale max_abs) for u and f_int; law energies 1e-12 relative; the total potential energy of TEST-127 cancels to 7e-18 between the two laws (+-0.0238), so it gets abs 1e-15 (4e-14 of the law energies).
rules.evidence: measured with crates/akantu-embedded/tests/oracle_fixtures.rs (max |port - oracle| / max |oracle|): t127 u 1.07e-15, f_int 1.45e-13, law energies within 1e-12, total energy within abs 1e-15; adversarial_2d K 9.3e-17, f_int 2.0e-16; prestress_2d_rest K 9.3e-17, f_int 9.0e-17; grazing_2d_1e-4 K 1.3e-17, f_int 0; grazing_2d_1e-10 bitwise values (order differs). Margins >= 7 (f_int of t127) and >= 100 elsewhere.

Bound: an entry of K is a sum of at most m <= 12 contributions (pieces touching the dof pair) of magnitude <= max|K|, so reordering changes it by at most m * eps * max|K| = 12 * 1.1e-16 * max|K| = 1.3e-15 max|K| -> 1e-14 (scale max_abs); the residual and the energies of a prescribed field inherit that bound per element sum, the solved displacement amplifies the perturbation of K by kappa(K) (TEST-127: kappa ~ 1e2..1e3 for 10840 dofs of a well-shaped mesh) -> 1e-12 (scale max_abs) for u and f_int; law energies 1e-12 relative; the total potential energy of TEST-127 cancels to 7e-18 between the two laws (+-0.0238), so it gets abs 1e-15 (4e-14 of the law energies).
rules.evidence: measured with crates/akantu-embedded/tests/oracle_fixtures.rs (max |port - oracle| / max |oracle|): t127 u 1.07e-15, f_int 1.45e-13, law energies within 1e-12, total energy within abs 1e-15; adversarial_2d K 9.3e-17, f_int 2.0e-16; prestress_2d_rest K 9.3e-17, f_int 9.0e-17; grazing_2d_1e-4 K 1.3e-17, f_int 0; grazing_2d_1e-10 bitwise values (order differs). Margins >= 7 (f_int of t127) and >= 100 elsewhere.
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026

rules.justification: Exact (rule EMB-BIT, docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md): the fixtures come from the patched oracle variant `embedded` (D-060; oracle/patches/embedded, docs/ORACLE_BUILD.md), which changes no formula. In upstream-compatible mode (collected set, upstream segment order, upstream tetrahedron triangles in 3-D) the port builds the same interface pieces (bitwise end points, same background elements) and evaluates the reinforcement kernels in upstream's Eigen order (strict oracle: -ffp-contract=off, -DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE), the solid model and the Eigen sparse LU solve bitwise (pinned Eigen cache sizes 16384/524288/524288, D-050), so every value must be bit-identical (f64::to_bits; signs of zero included; NaN per D-046, none in this corpus). The interface pieces are compared as a set (background element and end points) and, when the interface element order equals the oracle's, in place; when it differs (UD-408: the LGPL search structure cannot reproduce the CGAL AABB tree's order) the port's data are put in the oracle's order first. Integer quantities (connectivity, background elements, intersection kinds, K pattern) are exact.
rules.evidence: 15 cases generated three times identically on x86_64 (the x86_64 oracle host strict install READY e168f393, image 45122c21, run-time Eigen pin 16384/524288/524288, OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell); crates/akantu-embedded/tests/oracle_fixtures.rs: t125, t126, oblique, triangle6_oblique bitwise in place (every quantity); faces_grazing_3d (CGAL intersections) bitwise; t126 and t125 also bitwise in the default mode; expected errors of adversarial_3d / prestress_3d_rest reproduced; grazing_3d_* and face_z0_3d: documented UD-407 outcomes (see the test).
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
